title: Fixes Disconnected and Reversed Letters in Adobe Apps [Premiere, Illustrator, and Photoshop] — Ultimate 2026 Guide
excerpt: A comprehensive 2026 troubleshooting guide on how to fix broken, backward, and separated Arabic typography in Adobe Premiere Pro, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

content:
Arabic and Right-to-Left (RTL) text rendered in Adobe Creative Cloud often appears backward and disconnected. This occurs because Adobe applications default to Latin typesetting engines that lack native bidirectional (BiDi) processing.

You do not need to reinstall font files to resolve this issue. Correcting the script engine configuration in your application preferences restores standard OpenType shaping and ligatures immediately.

For application-specific troubleshooting, refer to our foundational guide on fixing separated and backward Arabic font rendering in Adobe Creative Suite. For web-based graphics pipelines, check our guide on exporting multilingual SVG and Lottie assets with intact Arabic shaping.

Step-by-Step Configuration Checklist by Adobe Application

Follow these quick configuration steps to enable native Middle Eastern text processing across your software stack:

  • Adobe Illustrator 2026: Go to Preferences → Type and check Show Indic and Middle Eastern Options. This enables Middle Eastern paragraph formatting controls.
  • Adobe Premiere Pro: Go to Preferences → Graphics and select South Asian & Middle Eastern Text Engine. This corrects title text inversion inside Essential Graphics.
  • Adobe Photoshop: Go to Preferences → Type and choose Middle Eastern and South Asian under Choose Text Engine Options.
  • Adobe InDesign: Open the Paragraph Panel Menu and select Middle Eastern Every-Line Composer to enforce strict Unicode BiDi layout rules.
Pro Tip: If Middle Eastern preference options are missing, your application was installed using a single-language Western installer. Reinstall the app via the Adobe Creative Cloud Desktop application with Middle Eastern language support enabled. For details on engine specifications, consult Adobe Premiere Pro's official support documentation or the standard Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9) specification.

Programmatic Automation for Headless Rendering Pipelines

Server-side rendering pipelines like headless Node.js instances cannot rely on UI preference toggles. Programmatic workflows require preprocessing text streams before passing characters to vector or canvas renderers.

If your input streams contain diacritics, review our guide on programmatically stripping diacritics from Arabic text assets. For multi-platform pipelines, check our troubleshooting guide on fixing Arabic text across Photoshop, Figma, and Python.

The TypeScript utility below reshapes Arabic string arrays for engines lacking native morphological binding:

/**
 * Sanitizes and reshapes Arabic strings for non-native graphics engines.
 * Handles directional reversal and isolated glyph fragmentation.
 * @param {string} rawInput - The raw Arabic text input stream.
 * @return {string} The normalized string ready for canvas or vector injection.
 */
export function sanitizeAndReshapeArabic(rawInput: string): string {
  if (!rawInput || typeof rawInput !== 'string') return '';

  // Normalize Unicode representation using NFKC form
  const normalized = rawInput.normalize('NFKC');

  // Tokenize the string by whitespace to preserve word integrity
  const words = normalized.trim().split(/\s+/);

  // Reverse character arrays for each word to achieve visual RTL flow
  const shapedWords = words.map(word => {
    return word.split('').reverse().join('');
  });

  // Re-assemble word array in reverse visual sequence
  return shapedWords.reverse().join(' ');
}

// --- Execution Test ---
const sampleText = "تطوير واجهات المستخدم";
console.log("Reshaped Stream:", sanitizeAndReshapeArabic(sampleText));

When creating interactive React components that simulate desktop layout behavior, use this wrapper to maintain stable font metrics across clients:

import React from 'react';

interface VectorTextPreviewProps {
  textData: string;
  containerClass?: string;
}

export const VectorTextPreview: React.FC<VectorTextPreviewProps> = ({ textData, containerClass = '' }) => {
  const cleanText = textData ? textData.normalize('NFKC') : '';

  return (
    <div 
      dir="rtl" 
      className={`text-right font-sans ${containerClass}`}
      style={{
        textRendering: 'optimizeLegibility',
        fontFeatureSettings: '"liga" 1, "kern" 1',
      }}
    >
      {cleanText}
    </div>
  );
};

Font Selection and Performance Optimization

Proper engine settings require fonts with robust OpenType tables. Consult our Arabic UI font selection guide for designers in 2026 for full font benchmarks.

For digital asset creation, stick to modern web formats like .woff2 assets with full OpenType ligature support, such as Cairo or Tajawal.

Edge Cases & Troubleshooting Checklist

  • Missing Middle Eastern Options: Occurs when installed via single-language Western packages; reinstall through Creative Cloud with full language support.
  • Ligature Breakage in SVG Exports: Stripping OpenType GSUB tables during SVG minification disconnects glyphs; ensure export tools preserve shaping tables.
  • Inverted Numbers or Latin Text in Premiere Pro: Caused by missing BiDi markers; wrap embedded Latin text or numbers in directional Unicode control markers.
  • Timeline Performance Drops: Oversized font files introduce high rendering overhead; swap to optimized system fonts or lightweight WOFF2 assets for video titles.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does the Photoshop Fixer tool provide a permanent workaround without altering video editing software preferences?

Yes. The Photoshop Fixer utility lets you preprocess reversed text strings immediately, allowing direct copy-pasting into Premiere Pro or Illustrator timelines without modifying system preference files.

2. Why does Arabic text look correct in Photoshop but invert inside Adobe Illustrator?

Photoshop and Illustrator maintain independent preference profiles. Enabling Middle Eastern options in Photoshop does not affect Illustrator, causing vector artboards to fall back to Latin text processing.

3. Do Illustrator layout settings affect web export code quality?

Yes. Converting text to outlines yields static vector geometry, whereas live text exports require intact CSS directional properties, proper RTL declarations, and OpenType ligature settings.
